items.information:
Preregistration via internet will be required. Preregistration finishes 15 February 2008.

items.name: Dutch Championship 2007
items.information: The Dutch Championship 2007 will be held during the toy fair Spellenspektakel 2007. Dutch Championship 2007 is only open to competitors with the Dutch nationality.

items.name: Wroclaw Open 2007
items.information:
Preregistration via internet is required. Preregistration closes June 24, 2007.
This competition is open to all people from all countries.
On-site registration on July 7, 2007 (Saturday) evening.
Competition starts at 9:00am on Sunday.

items.name: US Open 2007
items.information:
Prelims will be on the 16th. Semi-finals and finals will be on the 17th.
Registration fee will be $10 plus $2 per main event and $2 for any and all side events. (10 base, add 2 for each 
additional main event, add 2  if they're doing any side events). Participation in side events will be limited only to people 
that pre-register.

items.name: UC Berkeley Fall competition 2006
items.information:
Entrance fee $3 if you preregister, $5 if you don't.
Registration from 9:30-10am. Competition starts at 10am.
